_why: CEILINGS AND FLOORS, not targets. src/legacy.js may only shrink; src/render/** may only grow, and the extraction target is src/render/** PLUS src/screens/**. Regenerated by `node tests/monolith-ratchet.mjs --write` when a number moves the RIGHT way — never to make a red build green (CLAUDE.md §2).
_method: lines = physical lines (split on \r?\n). functions = column-0 `function name(` declarations, the same predicate as tests/no-duplicate-toplevel-fns.mjs. functionConsts = column-0 `const|let|var name = (async)? function|(|arg =>`. render = every *.js under src/render AND src/screens, recursively — both halves of the extraction target.
